prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site where soft edges blend with structural forms. On the left, a worker in a yellow vest stands firmly beside a tall steel beam, holding a clipboard tightly against his chest while looking down at the plans. Next to him, a spotted dog sits patiently on a pile of gravel, its tail curled around its paws. In the center, a foreman in an orange hard hat points decisively toward a distant crane, directing the attention of a woman in blue overalls who stands nearby with her hands on her hips. She looks intently at the direction he indicates, her posture rigid with focus. A silver ladder leans precariously against a concrete wall just behind them, its rungs faded by use. To the right, two laborers in gray shirts lift a heavy wooden plank together, their faces strained with effort as they coordinate their movements. One of them wears a green bandana, while the other has a visible tattoo on his arm. Near them, a wheelbarrow filled with wet cement rests on uneven ground, its handles stained with dried mixture. A black cat perches atop a stack of bricks in the foreground, watching the scene with wide, curious eyes. Behind the cat, a large excavator sits idle, its bucket resting on the dirt. A child in a red jacket stands near the safety barrier on the far right, holding a toy truck and observing the machinery with fascination. An engineer in a white shirt walks past the child, carrying a rolled-up blueprint under one arm. The background features a half-finished skeleton of a building, with exposed rebar reaching toward the sky. There is no heavy rain falling from the clouds. There is no bright sunlight casting sharp shadows.
